license_evidence: Mendeley study dataset page explicitly lists CC BY4.0, independently DataCite rightsList includes CC BY4 with expired 2018-07-19 embargo. GEO underlying deposition has no separate explicit license inspected yet.

schema.numeric_columns: Jurkat then K562; each Barcode Sequencing then Triple Sequencing then sgRNA Sequencing; each Replicate 1, Replicate 2, Replicate average

methods_findings: Replicate infections independent. Gamma is endpoint/T0 log2 enrichment, negative-control centered and divided by cell doublings.
Single-guide response obtained from pairs with negative control in other position.

Published GI scores fit quadratic expectation against all pairs for each query, normalize by negative-control/query variance and symmetrize; avoid as model input and use raw growth phenotype target to avoid global pair-derived label construction.
All guide variants and ordered orientations for a gene pair must share split.
Gene panel enriched for growth-essential genes, so cannot claim genome-wide or cross-cell-type generalization.
license_scope_caveat: CC BY4 is verified for author Mendeley dataset, whose description includes raw read counts and intermediate processing files. GEO is author-linked deposition for the same study. Exact file identity against Mendeley could not be proven because Mendeley API returns Cloudflare403. Do not claim the GEO file itself explicitly carries a CC license. Use as publicly deposited research data with attribution; raw dataset is kept outside git.
